nameEn: Retail sale in non-specialised stores with food, beverages or tobacco predominating
description: This class includes the retail sale of a large variety of goods of which food products, beverages or tobacco predominate.
includes: retail sale in supermarkets, hypermarkets and other large non-specialised food stores
retail sale in general stores where the predominant part of sales is food, beverages or tobacco
retail sale in grocery stores with a general food range
excludes: retail sale in stores where food is not predominating, see 4719
